ranking: fewest missing evidence requirements, conflicts last; not scientific confidence

findings.message: State the intended temperature domain before validation.

candidates.title: Crystallography-informed CEF baseline
candidates.description: Use an explicit site and constituent specification as a candidate CEF representation.
limitations: Crystal structure alone does not fix thermodynamic parameterization.
validation_tests: Site ratios and atomic composition agree.
Reference states and pure limits are consistent.
candidates.applicability: See trigger and required evidence; domain review required.

candidates.title: Subsystem compatibility review
candidates.description: Review subsystem descriptions together before combining them.
limitations: Guidance source remains a bibliographic lead in this release.
Structural preflight cannot certify Gibbs-energy equivalence.
validation_tests: Compare shared references and phase identities.
Test binary limits and multicomponent extrapolation.
candidates.applicability: See trigger and required evidence; domain review required.

candidates.title: Stage parameter assessment
candidates.description: Organize evidence and constrain models before progressively fitting additional terms.
limitations: This workflow does not determine a universal parameter order.
validation_tests: Compare independent thermochemical and constitutional observations after each stage.

candidates.title: Ternary topology and cross-section consistency
candidates.description: Cross-check phase-diagram sections, reactions and bounding subsystems before fitting.
candidates.applicability: Constitutional data from multiple diagram representations.
limitations: A low optimization residual cannot resolve contradictory interpretations.
validation_tests: Test phase-rule consistency and compatible phase fields and reaction connections.

candidates.title: Common unary functions and reference states
candidates.description: Identify exact unary functions and versions before combining fitted energies.
candidates.applicability: Any assessment importing DFT, another database or a subsystem.
limitations: A matching reference-state label alone does not establish matching functions.
validation_tests: Compare unary G,H,S and transitions across imported components.

candidates.title: Effective Bond Energy Formalism
candidates.description: Consider effective-bond parameterization for complex multisublattice phases.
limitations: Not an exact reconstruction of arbitrary independently specified endmember energies.
Matrix construction, rank tests and published numerical reproduction are not implemented.
validation_tests: Test independent higher-order endmember energies and ternary equilibria.
candidates.applicability: See trigger and required evidence; domain review required.

candidates.title: Evidence-supported sublattice reduction
candidates.description: Consider combining sites only when occupancy evidence supports the reduction over the intended domain.
limitations: Successful binary fitting does not establish multicomponent transferability.
validation_tests: Compare occupancy and equilibrium predictions before and after reduction.
candidates.applicability: See trigger and required evidence; domain review required.

context_note: Manual-context recipes require information absent from v1; discover them with search, not automatic applicability claims.
